integrity_notes: All displayed local rings are proved by the exact mod-four obstruction plus the formal implicit-function theorem; finite exhaustive computations are independently replayable but not used as substitutes for geometric proofs. Independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the Fermat equation over the unramified dyadic quadratic complete DVR. Does not assert a classification for other cubic-fourfold models. Classical 405 and 891 counts, full unrefined incidence graph, and hexacode uniqueness are credited as prior results. Historical priority is subject to unindexed literature.
title: The 405 horizontal and 486 vertical planes on a characteristic-two Fermat cubic fourfold
